description: This file defines a React component called RoleCard used in the Explore section of a job/career navigation application. It displays detailed information about a specific role, including title, description, skills, responsibilities, and compatibility score. It also manages user interactions such as expanding/collapsing details and setting a role as a target role.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes input to a trimmed string, handling null/undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a safe array of strings, filtering out non-arrays.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into cleaned, sentence-like strings with proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a numeric value between 0 and 100, rounding to nearest integer.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from various potential role object structures.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates skills from a persona object from different schema paths.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Converts a skill string to a normalized lowercase key for comparison.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds intersection of persona skills and role required skills, returning matched skills.
